description: Resolution table mapping all 13 ClawHub security audit findings to exact file:line locations in MEGAcmd skill files

findings.current_text: CLI for MEGA.nz cloud services. Use for upload, download, bidirectional sync, backups, WebDAV/FTP servers, FUSE mount (Linux), public link sharing, and MEGA account management.
findings.proposed_change: Refine description to be more specific and action-oriented. Remove 'or similar' patterns. Keep all capabilities but phrase concretely.

findings.lines: 22-40 (When to use / When NOT to use sections)
findings.current_text: No security overview banner exists near the top of the skill file
findings.proposed_change: Add security overview banner between 'When NOT to use' (L33) and 'Prerequisites' (L43) sections. Warn about powerful operations, confirmation requirement, credential safety.

findings.current_text: CLI para serviços MEGA.nz. Use para upload/download, sync bidirecional, backups, servidores WebDAV/FTP, montagem FUSE (Linux), compartilhar links públicos, e gerenciar conta MEGA.
findings.proposed_change: Same as F1 but translated to PT-BR. Refine description to be more specific.

findings.current_text: No security overview banner exists near the top of the PT-BR skill file
findings.proposed_change: Same as F2 but translated to PT-BR. Add security overview banner between sections.

findings.lines: L59 (prerequisites login), L81 (scriptable mode), L100-103 (Login table), README L175-179 (interaction modes)
findings.current_text: mega-login email password shown directly in examples without warnings about credential exposure
findings.proposed_change: Add banner warning before Login section (before L100) covering risks of inline credentials: shell history, process listings, agent telemetry. Note that syntax is shown for reference. Also warn in README where login examples appear.

findings.lines: L139-141 (export commands), L147-148 (share commands), L383 (--writable rule)
findings.current_text: mega-export and mega-share commands shown without warnings about data disclosure. --writable link warning exists but buried in Important Rules.
findings.proposed_change: Add banner warnings before export and sharing sections. Strengthen --writable rule to be more prominent. Cover accidental data disclosure, permission level awareness.

findings.lines: L209-217 (WebDAV section), L219-224 (FTP section), README.md L218 (Quick Example webdav --public)
findings.current_text: WebDAV and FTP commands ready-to-run without warnings about network exposure, public access, or unauthorized access risks
findings.proposed_change: Add prominent banner warnings before WebDAV and FTP sections. Cover: MEGA content exposure over network, localhost vs --public distinction, unattended service risks, TLS recommendation, plain FTP insecurity.

findings.lines: L59, L81, L100-103 (same structure as F5 but in PT-BR)
findings.current_text: Same issue as F5 but in Portuguese - mega-login email password shown directly
findings.proposed_change: Same as F5 but translated to PT-BR.

findings.lines: L337-354 (Action plan for stuck sync - find commands with -delete)
findings.current_text: find ~/sync-folder -name "*:Zone.Identifier" -delete 2>/dev/null runs automatic file deletion without warnings
findings.proposed_change: Add light single-line warning before the Action Plan block (before L337). One line only: '> :warning: The following commands delete local files without confirmation. Verify paths.'

findings.current_text: mega-session shown with 'Show session ID' description without warning about bearer token exposure
findings.proposed_change: Add warning near mega-session: session tokens are bearer credentials, exposure enables account takeover. Recommend not sharing session output.

findings.current_text: mega-masterkey shown with 'Save recovery key' description. Rule #3 mentions it's essential but no handling guidance.
findings.proposed_change: Add warning near mega-masterkey: master key is a recovery secret. Recommend encrypted storage, restricted file permissions. Strengthen Rule #3 with handling guidance.

findings.current_text: mega-proxy URL|--auto|--none shown without inline credentials, but command inherently supports credentials on command line
findings.proposed_change: Add generic warning note near proxy command: avoid passing credentials inline on command line, prefer environment variables or config files.

findings.current_text: mega-webdav /Public --public --port=8080 and mega-ftp commands shown without warning about remote attack surface
findings.proposed_change: Covered by F7 (WebDAV/FTP section). Add warning about public exposure enabling remote attack surface. Recommend TLS and caution with --public flag.
